# Mutation Kill Rate Absence Policy

If test mutation kill rate is absent (no [mutation] configured or no claimed slugs' components were scored), there is no penalty; mutation kill rate defaults to neutral (1.0).

To avoid penalizing tests for missing mutation data, matching an 'informational, not gating' posture outlined in ADR-012.
